cues: Resonance is useful and dangerous in equal measure.
A radio tunes in one station by resonating with it.
The sympathetic strings of a sitar ring all by themselves.
But soldiers break step when crossing a bridge, and in nineteen forty, wind drove the Tacoma Narrows bridge into resonance until it tore itself apart.
